column1: Supporting hero text in 1–3 short sentences:
column2: Ankahee is an online therapy practice offering individual and couples therapy across India in English, Hindi, Marwari, and Nepali. Whether you're feeling overwhelmed, navigating a difficult relationship, or simply trying to understand yourself better, therapy begins with a conversation
column3: Ankahee offers online individual and couples therapy across India in English, Hindi, Marwari, and Nepali. Get support for anxiety, relationships, life transitions, grief, identity, and everyday challenges, without having to wait until things feel unbearable.

column2:
Ankahee is an online therapy practice founded by Reetika and Manvi. We work with individuals and couples across India, supporting people through anxiety, relationship concerns, grief, trauma, burnout, ADHD, self-esteem, parenting and similar emotional challenges.

No two people arrive at therapy with the same story. We begin by understanding what brings you here, while also exploring the experiences, relationships, and environments that have shaped who you are. Together, we will make sense of how these continue to influence your life today, notice the patterns that may be keeping you stuck, and recognise the strengths that have helped you navigate difficult times. From there, we will work collaboratively to develop ways of responding that feel more intentional, flexible, and true to who you are.

column1: Three to six key services or support pathways to highlight on the homepage:
column2:
Individual Therapy: Online therapy for adults navigating anxiety, depression, stress, trauma, grief, ADHD, relationship concerns, self-esteem, identity, emotional regulation, and life transitions.

Couples Therapy: Support for couples looking to improve communication, navigate conflict, rebuild trust, strengthen intimacy, and work through life's challenges together.

Employee Assistance Programmes (EAP): Comprehensive mental health support for organisations through counselling, workshops, training programmes, wellbeing initiatives, and customised employee assistance programmes.

Workshops: Interactive workshops on mental health, emotional wellbeing, relationships, boundaries, stress management, resilience, and workplace wellbeing for communities, educational institutions, and organisations.

Training Programmes: Experiential training programmes for students, early-career mental health professionals, and organisations on counselling microskills, therapeutic relationships, reflective practice, and the foundations of meaningful therapeutic work.

column1: Three to five reasons to choose the practice, trust indicators, or differentiators:
column2:
Thoughtful, Evidence-Based Therapy
Our work draws from approaches including Cognitive Analytic Therapy (CAT), Internal Family Systems (IFS), CBT, DBT, and trauma-informed practice. We shape therapy around you, your goals, and what feels most meaningful, rather than following a fixed method.
Understanding Beyond Symptoms
We believe our thoughts, emotions, and relationships don't exist in isolation. Together, we'll explore the experiences, relationships, and environments that have shaped your life, helping you understand recurring patterns and discover ways of responding that feel more supportive and intentional.
Grounded in the Realities of Everyday Life
Whether you're navigating family expectations, relationship dynamics, workplace stress, identity, or major life transitions, therapy makes space for the cultural, social, and personal contexts that shape your experiences.
Therapy in the Language You Think In
Sessions are available in English, Hindi, Marwari, and Nepali, making it easier to express yourself in the language that feels most natural.
Beyond the Therapy Room
Alongside therapy, we work with organisations, educational institutions, and mental health professionals through workshops, training programmes, and Employee Assistance Programmes (EAPs), making mental health conversations more accessible in the communities where people live, learn, and work.
